Screen-reader walkthrough of both modes in VoiceOver and NVDA
Physical classroom projection judgment under room lighting

deviations: KaTeX visual HTML uses aria-hidden on .katex-html; exposed MathML retains the expression.
Same-screen animated code stepping was not added; successive complete code states are the MVP.
Chart SVG and data table are both generated from the block's held or bound data at build time.
Present mode has no panel scrolling: every section must fit 1920x1080; overflow fails the gate.
Present-mode floors: headings 40px/1.4, instructional 28px, chart/Mermaid text 24px, attribution 18px; code listings total at most 16 lines.
Review captures are viewport screenshots at 1920x1080, not element or full-page crops.
WCAG 2.1 A/AA-tagged axe scans plus mechanical SC checks are evidence only — not a Title II conformance claim.
Projection quality is also measured by the frozen selector-only instrument at projection-instrument.mjs.
Section source lineage is DERIVED from source_of_truth.canonical_file plus the section id; lecture/v1 carries no per-section lineage field.
